findings.title: Joined spans of time
findings.claim: The time named by the oath can be perceived as connected intervals whose continuity is carried from one span to the next.
findings.mechanism: The focus time carrier in وَٱلْعَصْرِ meets the joining image in both occurrences of تَوَاصَوْا in 103:3; the contact turns time from an empty container into a sequence held together by connection.
findings.reader_payoff: The oath's time acquires visible succession: intervals touch and carry continuity rather than merely passing beside one another.
findings.containment: The focus remains the ordinary temporal oath. The joining image is a pericope-bounded contextual resonance, and the packet does not establish a wider temporal system or a single exclusive interpretation of the two reciprocal verbs.

epistemic.reason: Trusted channel evidence supplies the exact focus and context branch nominations; the connected-spans synthesis is a qualified macro inference.

findings.title: Labor crew and earned provision
findings.claim: The temporal field can be pictured as a productive process in which deliberate work generates a return that is due and whose absence appears as loss.
findings.mechanism: The focus yield branch meets manual labor and wage images at عَمِلُوا, the due-return image at ٱلْحَقِّ, and general loss at خُسْرٍ; work therefore supplies the action, yield the output, entitlement the expected return, and loss the shortfall.
findings.reader_payoff: The human condition inside time becomes measurable as work receiving or failing to receive its produced return.
findings.containment: The ordinary oath by time remains intact. This is a pericope-bounded labor-and-return resonance, not a claim that the ayah literally names workers, wages, or a commercial contract.

epistemic.reason: The trusted nomination supplies all branch contacts and exact context occurrences; the productive-process relation remains a qualified contextual synthesis.

branch_activations.boundary: The finding does not decide whether the return is material or moral, and it does not activate the focus branch's withholding or reclamation pole.
